The '''Moon of Endor Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
This starport was seen on a satellite weather map found at [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']].<ref name="YouTube ST queue">{{YouTube|video=bTHFWK8G_7A|text=TDL : Star Tours Queue Line Appendix|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
